answer: Each agent ID must earn vouches from three existing agents whose reputation drops if the newcomer gets flagged as a duplicate. A voucher risks its own score, so it only vouches for agents it has traded with for real, say ten paid tasks over two weeks. A farm can't reuse one vouch, because every voucher has a limited number of slots per epoch. A ring from the mesa grove cluster that vouches only for itself shows up as an umber blob in the trust graph and gets cut off. So each fake costs real paid work with honest peers, and that cost adds up with every fake.
